segments.text: Good morning. We're starting sprint planning. Andrei, how's the database migration going?
The migration is done to 80 percent. I'll finish it by Wednesday, November 11th.
Good. Maria, what's on your list?
I'm doing the design for the dashboard screen. I'll send it for review by Friday.
Perfect. I had planned to integrate with PayPal, but the client has dropped it, so we won't do it in this sprint.
Then I'll take over the automated tests for payments, instead of the integration.
And someone should update the API documentation, it's two months old.
Maria, can you take care of the documentation after the design?
Yes, I'll update it by November 20th.
I'll send the progress report to the client on Monday morning.
The budget for servers remains 4500 euros per month?
Yes, 4500, no changes. Thank you all, see you on Thursday for the retrospective.
